Start: Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Mardu Siegebreaker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)

Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Yannik enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
  Repeat.

## Combo 3234-3293-3967-5226

Produces: Infinite self-mill; Infinitely large creature until end of turn; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Yahenni, Undying Partisan (battlefield); Lithatog (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Need for Speed (battlefield); Hammerhead, Maggia Boss (battlefield)

  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. Produces: Infinitely large creature until end of turn; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers
Start: Beifong's Bounty Hunters (battlefield); Reaper of Flight Moonsilver (battlefield); Cleveland Booker, Empath (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a land.
  You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
  You control another nonland creature.
Steps: Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
  When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
  Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
  Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land.
  When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
  Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
  Repeat.
